policy: Unlisted legacy claims remain explicitly UNVERIFIED, not source-verified. RETIRED means withheld pending a defensible source or wording; it does not assert that every part of the claim is false.

entries.reason: Unqualified first-ever claim and inventor ambiguity.
Historical anecdote without a reliable measurement source.
Confuses tropical ripening colour with fruit ancestry.
Unsourced lifetime average depends on assumptions.
Unsupported aircraft-carrier lifting extrapolation.

entries.startsWith: A single mature tree can produce
entries.reason: Species and growing conditions not specified.
Unsourced product-dependent estimate.
Universal folding limit lacks paper size and thickness constraints.
Superlative depends on vocabulary and definition of vowel.
Town size and energy definition unspecified.
Founding date does not establish first public access.
Undated changing record.

entries.startsWith: The longest word that can be typed
entries.reason: Typewriter is not an exhaustive top-row word record.

entries.replacement: One rotation of Venus takes about 243 Earth days, longer than its roughly 225-Earth-day year.
entries.reason: Clarifies sidereal rotation rather than sunrise-to-sunrise solar day.
Uncertain stellar radius and changing record.

entries.replacement: The Sun accounts for about 99.8% of the mass of our solar system.
entries.reason: Uses precision supported by the cited source.
Orbital period confirmed.

entries.replacement: Mercury's surface can reach about 430 degrees Celsius in daylight and fall to about minus 180 degrees Celsius at night.
entries.reason: Replaces vague change with sourced temperature extremes.

entries.replacement: Sound needs matter to travel through: a vacuum cannot carry ordinary sound waves, though plasma in space can support waves measured by instruments.
entries.reason: Removes contradictory claim that space has no particles.
Collision timing and likelihood are uncertain; the unconditional 4.5-billion-year prediction is outdated.
Core temperature confirmed.

entries.replacement: A comet's ion tail points away from the Sun, while its heavier dust tail can curve along the comet's orbit.
entries.reason: Distinguishes the two tails rather than claiming every tail is straight.
Universal origin claim omits other nucleosynthesis pathways.
Mass and small-car size analogy need a specimen-specific source.

entries.replacement: A 2022 study of three woodpecker species found their skulls acted as stiff hammers rather than shock absorbers during pecking.
entries.reason: Corrects the old shock-absorber explanation using direct experimental evidence.
Mirror behaviour does not settle interpretations of self-recognition.
Universal behavioural claim requires experimental context.
Every-atom provenance and relative production pathways are not established.

entries.startsWith: The human brain generates enough electrical
entries.reason: Confuses metabolic power consumption with extractable electrical output.
Bone turnover is tissue-dependent, not a complete ten-year replacement.
Strength metric and natural-material classification are not specified.

Questionable wording and missing primary historical evidence.

Right-handed defender story is an overgeneralisation of varied castle design.

entries.reason: Contested superlative and discontinuous settlement evidence.

entries.startsWith: The first photograph of a person
entries.reason: First-ever and accidental wording are not securely established.
